guards.issue: MECHANISM: DingyRug.cs:13-36 returns `options.WithCardPools(options.CardPools.Concat(ColorlessCardPool), options.CardPoolFilter)`, so every card REWARD (not shop stock, not combat generation) draws from the character pool PLUS the Colorless pool. The sim's card-reward path (rewards.create_reward_cards) takes its pool from `reward_pool_card_ids()` / `pool_card_ids()` over IRONCLAD_POOL and nothing widens it. REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- py audit/tools/relic_probes_b04.py stubs): a REGULAR-odds reward screen offers ['drum_of_battle', 'blood_wall', 'true_grit'] both with and without the relic, with zero Colorless options either way. Both sides are ported and no unported content is needed: Dingy Rug is Shop rarity in the transcribed grab bag (relic_pools.py:63 'RELIC.DINGY_RUG'), the Colorless pool is fully ported (executed: 53 cards in cards/pool.py's COLORLESS_POOL), and create_reward_cards already accepts a `pool` override -- its own docstring names 'Lead Paperweight passes the Colorless pool' as the precedent. So the capability the stub says is missing is present; only the widening is not. IMPLEMENTATION NOTE for whoever fixes it: this is NOT one of sweep C's 33 one-relic fixes. ModifyCardRewardCreationOptions has no method on the sim's Relic base at all (guard N1), and the sim's nearest hook, modify_card_reward_options (relics/base.py:172-176, dispatched at rewards.py:300-301), runs AFTER the options have been generated -- it can upgrade or enchant an option, not change the pool it was drawn from. A faithful fix needs a new pool-time hook, which is why .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md sweep C lists ModifyCardRewardCreationOptions among the hooks it EXCLUDED from that count. RULE 7: rewards.py, cards/pool.py, relic_pools.py and relics/base.py are not hashed here.

guards.what: G2: all four of DingyRug.ModifyCardRewardCreationOptions' early returns -- `Owner != player` (DingyRug.cs:15-18), `Flags.HasFlag(NoCardPoolModifications)` (:19-22), `!Flags.HasFlag(IsCardReward)` (:23-26), `CardPools.Contains(ColorlessCardPool)` (:27-30) and `CustomCardPool != null` (:31-34)
guards.issue: Recorded as a group and carrying G1's verdict, because with no hook there is nothing for any of them to gate. They are listed rather than skipped because three of them are load-bearing for the FIX and easy to lose: IsCardReward is what confines the effect to reward screens (shop stock and in-combat generation must stay character-pool only, which is why the sim's existing shop and combat paths must not be changed); the already-contains-Colorless clause makes the append idempotent when two sources widen the same options; and CustomCardPool != null exempts callers that pinned their own pool (Lead Paperweight's Colorless-only reward, Kaleidoscope's cross-character pool). NoCardPoolModifications is the generic opt-out flag. The owner clause is multiplayer and out of scope.
